proof_in_the_paper: From the XRD pattern, Pd(111) measured as a dominant plane in XRD, d-spacing/lattice parameter of PdBInc./C was calculated to be 2.334/4.044 Å from 38.54°. The d-spacing/lattice parameter from fast Fourier transform (FFT) and the line profile of PdBInc./C in TEM was measured to be avg. 2.345/4.062 and 2.338/4.050 Å, which also correspond well with the XRD results (Figures 1b and S2c). For Pd/C, the d-spacing/lattice parameter was measured to be 2.331/4.037 Å from 38.6° in XRD, 2.334/4.044 Å in FFT, and 2.325/4.027 Å in the line profile (Figures 1a and S2a,b).
